name: Group Interactions
description: Shared tasks and gatherings for three or more adults. A and B are the people with a named role, the others are the rest of the requested cast; a group never adds people.

entries: A writing on a board while the others face it from staggered positions.
A showing a tool while the others watch from a loose semicircle outside its working area.
A group seated in a circle facing inward, A holding up an object for discussion while the others turn toward it with space between their seats.
A group spreading a large cloth over a table, each holding a separate section along its edge.
A group seated around a meal, passing dishes through the spaces between place settings.
A group building a model, each assembling a separate part around an uncluttered central surface.
A group gathered around a worktable, A steadying a workpiece, B aligning a tool and the others sorting parts along separate edges.
A aligning an empty space in a stack of crates while the others approach from separate sides with their loads.
A group passing one supply item along a line, A receiving it at one end, B handing it over and the others waiting within reach along the line with hands free.
A group carrying a rigid frame horizontally, A and B at the ends and the others spaced along its sides, each gripping a separate section and sharing the load.
A group sorting supplies into containers, A checking a list, B placing an item and the others arranging separate piles around the shared surface.
A group loading a cart, A holding its handles steady, B placing a box in its center and the others waiting beside separate boxes outside the loading path.
A group walking in single file along a narrow trail, leaving space between each person's steps.
A group standing shoulder to shoulder in a line, each facing forward on their own feet while A at the end gestures toward a shared destination.
A group examining a map laid flat, A pointing from one side, B holding a corner and the others leaning in from the remaining sides without overlapping hands.
A group assembling a shelter, A bracing an upright pole, B tensioning a line and the others securing separate supports around its perimeter.
A group cleaning a room, each working in a separate area with tools kept outside the others' paths.
A group planting a garden bed, A kneeling to dig, B holding a seedling and the others spacing containers along the outside edge, keeping the bed clear of feet.
A facing the others and marking the rhythm of a rehearsal while they stand in a shallow arc with room to move their arms.
A group resting on a broad platform, A seated upright at one edge, B reclining with their back supported, and the others sitting with separate space for their legs.
